newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Summit agrees new round of European arms talks.
newsitem.headline: Summit agrees new round of European arms talks.

text.p: A European security summit of more than 50 nations agreed on Monday to start a new round of conventional arms talks which would adapt and extend a 1990 treaty that reduces military hardware across the continent.

Portuguese Prime Minister Antonio Guterres announced at the opening session of the two-day summit that agreement had been reached. "This is a major achievement which, by itself, will justify this summit," he told the assembled leaders.
